name: chhath-mgmt-api
comment:type: The Worker source has always been ESM (src/index.js uses `export default`), which is how wrangler builds it. Declaring it here changes nothing about the deploy — it just lets Node itself parse the same files, so the test suite can import the real source instead of a copy.

scripts.lint:errors: ! grep -rn --include=*.js -E "^[^/*]*throw new Error\(" src/ || (echo '^^ audit H-3: use ValidationError(msg) for a user-facing message (400, not logged) or InternalError(msg[, userMsg]) for a server fault (500, logged).' && false)

comment:lint:errors: Guards audit H-3. A bare `throw new Error(...)` is untyped, so index.js treats it as an unexpected server fault: HTTP 500, message replaced by 'Something went wrong on the server', and a row in error_log. That was right for ~30 of the throws and wrong for ~75 of them. The leading `[^/*]*` skips lines that are comments quoting the old code.
comment:dependencies: web-push-browser is the ONLY runtime dependency of the Worker. Web Push needs a VAPID ES256 JWT plus an aes128gcm-encrypted payload (RFC 8291/8292); Node's `web-push` cannot run on Workers because it needs node:crypto. This library is zero-dependency, ESM, and built on the Web Crypto API the Worker already uses, and it defaults to aes128gcm (the encoding Safari/iOS requires). See src/push.js.
